purpose: Frozen outcome classification taxonomy distinguishing SCIENTIFIC failure from INVALID infrastructure. Never convert infrastructure failure into behavioral insufficiency. Never silently discard failures.

BEHAVIOR_FAIL.meaning: behavior_sufficient == 0 AND preservation_pass == 1 (frozen F2P not all passing on scoped reference patch)

PRESERVATION_FAIL.meaning: behavior_sufficient == 1 AND preservation_pass == 0 (behavior passed but a frozen stable-pass preservation identity regressed)

PATCH_APPLICATION_INVALID.meaning: the scoped reference patch could not be applied cleanly (rejects/conflicts) to the frozen parent state under the frozen patch semantics

TEST_CONTRACT_INVALID.meaning: frozen behavior/preservation contract cannot be instantiated for this task (frozen F2P node set missing/unresolved, bad node identity, evaluator boundary not resolvable)

ENVIRONMENT_INVALID.meaning: the frozen environment cannot be materialized/run as frozen (clean-state, dependency, or evaluator-environment defect), not a scientific outcome

INFRASTRUCTURE_TRANSIENT.meaning: recognized transient infrastructure signature (container startup, network blip, transient filesystem error) matching a PREDECLARED signature, no scientific result produced
INFRASTRUCTURE_TRANSIENT.retry: ALLOWED once, only if matched signature and no scientific result; retry must not alter scope/patch/env/test contract/timeout/arm/task; both attempts recorded

INFRASTRUCTURE_FATAL.meaning: infrastructure failure not matching any predeclared transient signature or persisting past the retry; owner review required

ARM_PREDICTION_INVALID.meaning: the frozen arm prediction artifact for this task/arm is invalid (unresolvable, malformed, or a listed path fails the added-file rule and cannot be recovered); recorded, never counts as scientific failure

OPWS_INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE.meaning: a validity/control arm (GOLD or SELECT_ALL) failed for a reason attributable to the behavior/preservation contract; the task is OPWS_INVALID and is NOT a scientific arm failure

UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED.meaning: any unclassifiable failure; treated as fail-closed, owner review required, never silently dropped

hard_rules: Infrastructure failure is never converted into behavioral insufficiency.
Failures are never silently discarded; every classified record is written and counted.
OPWS_INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE and ARM_PREDICTION_INVALID tasks are reported in OPWS_INVALID_TASKS.json with reason; they are excluded from arm scientific denominators with the reason visible.
UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED blocks scientific interpretation until owner review.
